availability_boundary: Original first-version values remain the only candidate prior to 2017-08-15 acceptance; a later revised value, if qualified, may only be considered after a separately conservative next-session gate. Never overwrite the first source bytes or pre-amendment signal history.
stop: Any transport/size/NAS/identity/printed-total failure stops this fixed amendment source version without retry or alternative URL.
